configSchema.name: locationId
configSchema.description: GoHighLevel location (sub-account) ID. Required.

configSchema.name: pipelineId
configSchema.description: GoHighLevel pipeline ID that opportunities are created in. Required.

configSchema.name: stageMappings
configSchema.description: Optional. Key: a Terros workflow stage. Value: the GoHighLevel pipeline stage name. Outgoing (Account Sync): a key equal to the Terros stage NAME picks the GoHighLevel stage; with no match the Terros stage name is used as is. Incoming (Opportunity Webhook): the GoHighLevel stage name is looked up among the values and its key is sent to Terros, so use a Terros stage ID as the key (or a name listed in the workflow integration mappings). With no match the GoHighLevel stage name is sent, and Terros ignores it unless the workflow integration mappings know it.

configSchema.name: contactFieldMappings
configSchema.description: Optional. Key: a Terros account field (for example account.owner.email) or custom field ID (CF.…). Value: a GoHighLevel merge field such as {{ contact.owner_email }}.

configSchema.name: opportunityStages
configSchema.description: Optional. Comma-separated Terros stage names, for example Appointment Set, Contract Signed. An account entering one of them gets a GoHighLevel opportunity if it has none. Case is ignored. Blank means Appointment Set.

configSchema.name: opportunityIdFieldId
configSchema.description: Optional. Terros custom field ID (CF.…) that receives the GoHighLevel opportunity ID. A value not starting with CF. is ignored with a warning.

configSchema.name: alertWebhookUrl
configSchema.description: Optional. URL that receives a JSON POST when a sync needs attention (Account Sync: an account in an opportunity stage has no closer; Appointment Sync: an appointment create or change was refused; Appointment Webhook: the GoHighLevel assignee of an appointment has no matching Terros user). A failed delivery is only logged.

configSchema.name: alertRecipients
configSchema.description: Optional. Comma-separated emails. Only copied into the alert webhook JSON as recipients; this integration sends no email, so the receiver of alertWebhookUrl must act on them.

configSchema.name: disabled
configSchema.description: Kill switch. Type true to make this script do nothing. Blank or false: run normally. Any other text, including a typo, counts as true.

configSchema.name: dryRun
configSchema.description: Type true to log what this script would write without writing anything. Blank or false: run normally. Any other text, including a typo, counts as true.
